user_request: 那就按这个方案开始实验，一层模型保留模59加法，对比四路不同尺度和四路同尺度。训练前先告诉我具体配置、跑多少条曲线、记录哪些指标和预计耗时，结果用 SwanLab 展示。
normalization: Unit L2 norm of complete two-sided finite propagation kernel; independent of samples and labels.
input: b occupies query; far a and near distractor c on left share role 1; gap role 0; query role 3; token residue+1; no positional embedding.
data_contract: 870/2611 ordered pairs split first using historical split_seed=0; fixed train=4 layouts per training pair; no online resampling; test_familiar=unseen pairs/familiar geometry, seen_new=seen pairs/heldout geometry, test_new=unseen pairs/heldout geometry; independent nuisance c in every split.
optimizer: Full-batch float32 AdamW; biases and LayerNorm excluded from decay; TF32 off; CUDA graph; exact query-only equivalent checked against original local recurrence.
scope: 2 groups x 3 seeds; all-long is not tuned best-common-scale; no automatic extra training.
